gen-dafont-redux-gf-montserrat-alternate: Contemporary and geometric, Redux sprawls wide with big looping entrances. Redux is the louder one, a felt-marker swell on every curve, while Montserrat Alternates is the finer one, a spaghetti-thin line that crowds up toward the capitals.
gen-dafont-sophia-archivo: Understated, Sophia writes in a flowing pen hand with no swell on its strokes. Archivo takes over below with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, so a long passage feels steady and approachable.
gen-dafont-sophia-fs-asap: Sophia's pen-written letters flow with mouths held open and no calligraphic swell on any downstroke, a soft script with a tall body. Asap's nearly capital-height lowercase makes it the readable partner.
gen-dafont-sophia-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a thick, heavy-looking strip of text with its curves held open, a crisp plain sans under Sophia's script. A longer passage reads dense and sure.
gen-dafont-sophia-manrope: Pen-written flow up top, a script with open curves and short stems. Manrope sits beneath with a bright gap at every curve's mouth and a minimal step from capital to lowercase, so a long passage reads easily.
gen-dafont-sophia-satoshi: Approachable and understated, the pair splits its jobs cleanly. Sophia does the flowing pen-written script best, while Satoshi does the soaring, wide-open lowercase best, every stroke cut to one width.
gen-dafont-sophia-switzer: Sophia's flowing, pen-written letters hold their mouths open and carry almost no stroke contrast. And Switzer, a tall-waisted sans of wire-like tubular forms, gives that looseness a crisp Swiss footing.
gen-dafont-sophia-work-sans: Understated and modern, Sophia lets its pen-written script flow with open curves. And Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line and sturdy joins, keeps a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-cascadia-code: Dreamy, widely spaced letters under a thick dark stripe of lowercase. Cascadia Code answers with a wire-like monoline skeleton and smooth bends, so a long passage moves along with generous gaps between neighbors.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono is a compact sans whose curves match its stems, standing like pins in a wide board. But if Starborn's ethereal, widely spaced heading is made small, its dark lowercase stripe loses its drama.
